actions: Check system uptime to confirm the reboot happened.
Check the OpenSSH SSH Server service status (Get-Service sshd).
Find what is listening on port 22: netstat -ano | findstr :22 — report the owning PID and process name.
If sshd is the listener but not completing handshakes, restart the service and re-test from inside: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no bruce@127.0.0.1.
Check Windows Event Viewer Application log for recent sshd errors and report them.
Do NOT change firewall rules, reinstall OpenSSH, or modify sshd_config without asking.
context: After today's reboot, TCP to port 22 connects but the SSH handshake is closed immediately (no banner). The service previously reported Running while refusing handshakes.
task: Diagnose why OpenSSH on this laptop accepts TCP on port 22 but closes SSH connections immediately.
